ActivityFilter.description: The case list filter a count stands for: the parameters, not a URL.
ActivityFilter.title: ActivityFilter

ActorView.description: A role or a permission set holding scopes the step's actions need.
ActorView.title: ActorView

AgreementBody.description:
How the customer agreed to the confirmation (ticket 28), and their
reply on the case when the person records it from one.
AgreementBody.title: AgreementBody

AgreementView.description:
How the customer agreed, as a person recorded it (ticket 28): in
words, from their reply and its located sentences when recorded from
one, or by silence.
AgreementView.title: AgreementView

AnchorRef.description:
Where the case view anchors the value: the line (None for the
request's or the PO's own fields) and the field its ``anchors`` key it by.
AnchorRef.title: AnchorRef

AppliedChangeView.description:
A value of the line the customer asked to change by mail, which a
person confirmed (ticket 27): it replaces the value above where the line
is entered. Never an amount.
AppliedChangeView.title: AppliedChangeView

ApprovalAsked.description:
Who the case was sent to, stamped when it was sent: the approval, the
scope its decider must hold and who that is, the version of the case the
approver is shown, and who sent it. A later reader takes this stamp, never
the rules in force today.
ApprovalAsked.title: ApprovalAsked

ArtifactView.description:
One stored file: what the approval view shows beside it (template,
case version, hash), and whether this caller may download it now.
ArtifactView.title: ArtifactView

AskBody.description:
A question to the status assistant (ADR 0007). Which conversation it
continues is the route's (ticket 46): the caller's general one, or their
one on the case the path names; never an id the body sends.
AskBody.title: AskBody

AssigneeBody.description: Who the case is given to; null gives it to nobody (every PIC's).
AssigneeBody.title: AssigneeBody

AssigneeView.description: A member the case may be given to.
AssigneeView.title: AssigneeView

AssistantAskBody.description: A question, and the session it continues (None opens one).
AssistantAskBody.title: AssistantAskBody

AssistantQuestionKind.description: What DW2 answers, and everything else.
AssistantQuestionKind.title: AssistantQuestionKind

AuditActorKind.description:
Who the actor of an event was, as the customer's trail shows it.

`support` is a member of the support team acting under a grant: the event
names the grant (`details.support_grant_id`) AND its actor is the person
that grant was assigned to. The grant id alone is not enough, because the
customer's own request, approval and revocation of a grant carry it too and
were done by the customer's people.
AuditActorKind.title: AuditActorKind

AuditEventView.description:
One audit row as the screen shows it.

``actor_id`` is here because it was the one thing the table could not show:
the column exists on the row and is not inside ``details``, so dropping it
from this view made "who did this" unanswerable from the UI for every action,
not only sharing (spec 03.1 BR10 names it explicitly).

``actor_display_name`` is the actor's name today (``None`` for an actor
that is no user, such as a background lane), and ``actor_kind`` says
whether the actor was the support team acting under a grant: support
staff are no member of the customer's, so a name alone would not say it.
AuditEventView.title: AuditEventView

AutomationStep.description:
The steps of DW2 that have a switch: each one code reads where the
step happens. The other steps of the twelve (CONTEXT.md, "Automation")
get theirs the day they are built, never before (failure-modes #1).
AutomationStep.title: AutomationStep

BaselineBody.description:
Accept the latest Bravo fingerprint as the watch's new baseline
(ticket 65): which one, and why (the UAT replay that passed).
BaselineBody.title: BaselineBody

BravoExport.description: One uploaded export and what became of it (module docstring).
BravoExport.title: BravoExport

BravoExportBody.description:
A Bravo screen exported by Sales (tickets 16, 03): which screen, the
file's name and its bytes, base64, decoded here and never opened: the
worker reads it in the reader sandbox.
BravoExportBody.title: BravoExportBody

BravoPoLayout.description: The import file's shape, as the tenant's Bravo expects it.
BravoPoLayout.title: BravoPoLayout

BravoReadBack.description:
A case's sales order as Bravo held it when last read, against the case
version it was compared with (module docstring).
BravoReadBack.title: BravoReadBack

BravoWriteBody.description:
A change of one SO line to write into Bravo (ticket 53): what changes
and to what. Which Bravo row, and its rowversion, are read by DW.
BravoWriteBody.title: BravoWriteBody

CancelResult.description:
Whether a run was actually stopped, not whether the request was understood.

`False` is an ordinary answer: the turn had already finished, or another
process holds it. A caller pressing Stop twice should get 200 both times —
the second one describes a thread that is already not running, which is what
they asked for.
CancelResult.title: CancelResult

CardDecisionRequest.description:
A person's decision on a triage card: the step they take (the card's
own or another of the closed set), None to dismiss it; ``attach`` to
attach a reply to the case the card names. Never a case id: the only
case a card may lead to is its own.
CardDecisionRequest.title: CardDecisionRequest

CardVerdict.description: What a person did with a card, and when.
CardVerdict.title: CardVerdict

CaseChange.description:
What a mutation answers: ids only, so an idempotent replay keeps no
request content.
CaseChange.title: CaseChange

CaseChangeView.description: What a mutation answers: which case, at which version, in which state.
CaseChangeView.title: CaseChangeView

CaseConversationView.description: A case talked about, on the assistant page's short list.
CaseConversationView.title: CaseConversationView

CaseReply.description:
A message attached to a case because its thread headers name a message
already on that case, of the sender's own customer (ticket 32).
CaseReply.title: CaseReply

CaseReplyView.description:
A customer's reply attached to the case by its thread (ticket 32), with
the thread intents a model read in it (ticket 26) and the step code
proposes from that, now.

``proposal`` is computed from the case's status as it is now, and only for
the newest message of the case's thread, a reply or one Sales sent: an
older one's reading does not pre-select anything. It is a suggestion: the
step is the existing one, which Sales confirms and the server checks as
for any other caller. The quotes are the customer's sentences, shown to a
case reader as the inbox shows the whole mail.
CaseReplyView.title: CaseReplyView

CaseStatus.description: Where a purchase case stands (CONTEXT.md, "Purchase case").
CaseStatus.title: CaseStatus

CaseVersionBody.description: The version of the case the caller saw: a stale one is refused (409).
CaseVersionBody.title: CaseVersionBody

CatalogImportView.description: An import as the page shows it: who, when, which file, how far.
CatalogImportView.title: CatalogImportView

CatalogInForceView.description:
Where a list's rows come from now: an approved snapshot, the mock, or
``none``: no approved snapshot where nothing stands in for one (deployed,
audit finding 1), and then no ``as_of`` either.
CatalogInForceView.title: CatalogInForceView

CatalogList.description:
The lists Sales maintains by hand. The ERP's own records (its sales
orders and open YCBG) are not among them: they come from Bravo.
CatalogList.title: CatalogList

CatalogPreviewView.description:
A proposed snapshot against the list in force now: rows added,
changed (old to new) and removed, and the rows the file had that will
not be applied.
CatalogPreviewView.title: CatalogPreviewView

CatalogUploadBody.description:
A master-data file (ticket 41): its name and its bytes, base64. The
bytes are decoded here and never opened: the worker reads them in the
reader sandbox.
CatalogUploadBody.title: CatalogUploadBody

CellDifference.description:
One cell the replay did not reproduce: where (the PIC's file's cell),
what was expected and what came out, and what produced it (the
customer's rule for the column, its step that could not apply, or the
layout). Carries the cells' values: price-bearing, as the key is.
CellDifference.title: CellDifference

ChangeLineBody.description: One change line a person types, on the case version they saw.
ChangeLineBody.title: ChangeLineBody

ChangeLineView.description: One value a customer's mail asks to change (`ChangeLine`).
ChangeLineView.title: ChangeLineView

ChangeRejectBody.description: Why one change line is rejected, in the person's words.
ChangeRejectBody.title: ChangeRejectBody

ChangeRequestBody.description:
A change request from one of the order's replies (ticket 27): the
mail, and any line the person types besides what DW1 reads, on the
case version the person saw.
ChangeRequestBody.title: ChangeRequestBody

ChangeRequestResult.description:
What a change-request decision returns: the request as it now stands
and the case's version after it (the next decision names it).
ChangeRequestResult.title: ChangeRequestResult

ChangeRequestView.description:
A change request on the order (ticket 27, dw_sales ADR 0010), with
the mail's newest part its anchors index into: the customer's own words.
The mail may state a price, so its text is served only to a holder of
`sales.price.read`, as the mail text of a PO read from the body is; for
anyone else it is absent, and the lines' own words stand.
ChangeRequestView.title: ChangeRequestView

CheckView.description:
Code's check of the model's answer: passed, refused with the reason
code, or not run because no answer came.
CheckView.title: CheckView

CodeUnavailable.description: Why the portal offers no code. Each one is a sentence on the page.
CodeUnavailable.title: CodeUnavailable

ColumnRule.description:
One column of the upload file, by its letter in the tenant's layout:
where its value starts (a field of the normal reading, or the customer's
record; none only where the first step is a constant) and the steps it
then goes through, in order.
ColumnRule.title: ColumnRule

Concat.description: Appends the values of other fields, each after the separator.
Concat.title: Concat

Confirmation.description: A supplier's confirmation of one order, read from one mail.
Confirmation.title: Confirmation

ConfirmationCopyView.description:
A message Sales sent on the case's thread carrying the processed
Excel DW1 made at this case version (by sha256), while the confirmation
is ahead of the order: it proposes "Ghi đã gửi xác nhận", from that
mail's time (ticket 28). A suggestion: the PIC records it.
ConfirmationCopyView.title: ConfirmationCopyView

ConfirmationMail.description:
A verified mail from the supplier of one of a case's orders that names
the order, not read yet: what a buyer presses "DW2 đọc" on.
ConfirmationMail.title: ConfirmationMail

ConfirmationView.description:
The confirmation that left (ticket 28): when (the clock of silence),
the sent copy it was recorded from, and, for a customer with days of
silence, the term and the instant it counts as agreement. None of the
two: never by silence.
ConfirmationView.title: ConfirmationView

ConfirmedDateChange.description: "XN giao hàng": the line's confirmed delivery date.
ConfirmedDateChange.title: ConfirmedDateChange

ConfirmedLine.description:
One line as the supplier confirmed it; None where the mail says
nothing of that value.
ConfirmedLine.title: ConfirmedLine

ConfirmedView.description: A confirmed decision: DW1's sentence, and the case's new version.
ConfirmedView.title: ConfirmedView

Constant.description: The value is this fixed text.
Constant.title: Constant

ConversationView.description: A conversation as its person sees it; before its first turn, empty.
ConversationView.title: ConversationView

ConvertGap.description: One customer code Bravo does not answer with an approved row.
ConvertGap.title: ConvertGap

ConvertGapsView.description:
The gaps, and whether an approved Bravo convert list was read at all:
without one, nothing can be said to be missing from it.
ConvertGapsView.title: ConvertGapsView

CopperBasisView.description: How a price follows copper. A band's limits are prices of copper.
CopperBasisView.title: CopperBasisView

Copy.description: Keeps the value as it is.
Copy.title: Copy

CorrectionBody.description:
One value a `value_uncertain` flagged, as Sales reads it on the source:
the field it is, and the value as text, which the case validates as that
field's type (a number, a date, a unit, text).
CorrectionBody.title: CorrectionBody

Coverage.description: How far this slice takes the step.
Coverage.title: Coverage

CrossCheck.description: What code found, stamped on the case when it goes to its approver.
CrossCheck.title: CrossCheck

CustomerNotationBody.description:
How the customer writes one kind, as a person states it (ticket 37):
the kind and its value, checked against the values the kind holds.
CustomerNotationBody.title: CustomerNotationBody

CustomerNotationView.description:
A customer's notation: each kind known, what it rests on, and the
values each kind may hold (the platform's one list, so a screen offers
exactly what the server takes).
CustomerNotationView.title: CustomerNotationView

CustomerReminderView.description: A draft, or why there is none; always marked as the model's.
CustomerReminderView.title: CustomerReminderView

CustomerSalesOrderRules.description: One customer's columns: each named once.
CustomerSalesOrderRules.title: CustomerSalesOrderRules

Cut.description:
Keeps the characters from ``start`` to before ``end`` (from 0; a
negative number counts from the end; none: the start or the end).
Cut.title: Cut

Decided.description: The approver's decision, as the approval recorded it.
Decided.title: Decided

DecisionConfirmBody.description:
The PIC confirms the decision a turn stated (ticket 56): its hash,
which binds the confirmation to exactly the words said. What is decided
is the stored turn's, never anything this body sends.
DecisionConfirmBody.title: DecisionConfirmBody

DeliveryScheduleView.description:
One delivery of a line's quantity (ticket 21), as the line is entered
(a schedule the PO prints is never typed over): where it is printed,
DW1's suggested date for it, and, on a line the PO splits, the date Sales
confirmed for it (ticket 35).
DeliveryScheduleView.title: DeliveryScheduleView

Demonstration.description:
One decided line a version shows: the customer's description and the
PRV code a person kept. The reading shows the code's attributes from the
item master, never the code (`model_reading.shown_lines`).
Demonstration.title: Demonstration

Derivation.description:
How the bytes a PO was read from were made from the customer's file
(ticket 27): converted from a legacy Office format, or read by OCR from
images of its pages. The tool's own version is kept: another converter or
engine is another reading of the same file.
Derivation.title: Derivation

DescriptionReading.description:
What a model reading did for one line, stamped on its check basis.

``read``: every check passed, and ``spans`` are what the candidates were
computed from. ``not_understood``: a check refused it (``reason``).
``unavailable``: no usable answer (the model down, timed out, or its
output invalid); the line is unmapped exactly as without the model.
DescriptionReading.title: DescriptionReading

DescriptionReadingView.description:
What a model reading of the description did (dw_sales ADR 0005).
``outcome``: ``read``, ``not_understood`` (``reason`` says which check
refused it) or ``unavailable`` (no usable answer: DW1 could not read it).
DescriptionReadingView.title: DescriptionReadingView

DesignBasePriceView.description:
A QUOTE line's BP as Bravo's "Danh mục Base price" holds it (ticket
11), for a price reader only: ``found`` False is a BP code the list read
does not hold (B21 exports the latest BPs only), never a blank price.
DesignBasePriceView.title: DesignBasePriceView

DesignCheck.description:
Design's result on a whole YCBG, read from Bravo (ticket 16), never
written there: Bravo's status is Design's to close. Read from the YCBG
export a person uploaded (``file_sha256``, ``read_by``) until the
vendor's API reads a request back by its number (R13).
DesignCheck.title: DesignCheck

DesignCheckLine.description:
Design's result on one line of the YCBG, as Bravo holds it once the
line is closed: QUOTE with the BP code it is quoted under, or DECLINE
with Design's reason.
DesignCheckLine.title: DesignCheckLine

DesignRequestStateView.description: Sales asked Design to create a PRV code for this line, and waits (ticket 06).
DesignRequestStateView.title: DesignRequestStateView

DesignRequestView.description:
The request to Design for one line, drafted from the case for a person
to send, and the codes Design named since it was recorded sent (who
recorded it, and when, is the order's own `design_requests`).
DesignRequestView.title: DesignRequestView

DesignTextReadingView.description:
What DW1 read of a Design reply written in the mail, for Sales to
confirm; always marked as the model's.
DesignTextReadingView.title: DesignTextReadingView

DiffRow.description: A record as its template row prints it.
DiffRow.title: DiffRow

Difference.description: Where a confirmation and its order part, as text a buyer reads.
Difference.title: Difference

Disposition.description: What DW2 did with one mail.
Disposition.title: Disposition

DraftProblem.description:
Why a draft is not, or not wholly, what the template says. Names a
field, a cell and that cell's own text: never a word of the model's.
DraftProblem.title: DraftProblem

DraftView.description:
What the requester's page shows after DW2 read their words: the
draft, what the form rules still ask for, or why there is none.
DraftView.title: DraftView

EdgeAction.description: What makes a case move: the domain method that moves it.
EdgeAction.title: EdgeAction

EdgeGuard.description: What the domain refuses a move without.
EdgeGuard.title: EdgeGuard

EndpointIn.description: A subscription named by its endpoint, to turn it off.
EndpointIn.title: EndpointIn

EvidenceView.title: EvidenceView

ExampleFileBody.description:
One file of a worked example (ticket 38): its name and its bytes,
base64, decoded here and never opened: the worker reads it in the reader
sandbox.
ExampleFileBody.title: ExampleFileBody

ExampleSubmissionBody.description: "Gửi duyệt": the number the new version of the customers' rules takes.
ExampleSubmissionBody.title: ExampleSubmissionBody

ExportMapping.description:
A customer portal's export (ticket 18): the title of each column read,
the column saying whether a row is a firm order, and the values of it
that mean firm. Every other row is a forecast, counted and never ordered.
The export prints no currency, so the person mapping it states the one
the customer orders in; each PO read with it has that value flagged
`not_printed`, for Sales to confirm.
ExportMapping.title: ExportMapping

ExportOutcome.description:
What became of one document of an export: its number (a YCBG's, a
customer PO's) and the case, never a value of the file.
ExportOutcome.title: ExportOutcome

ExportRow.description:
One surveyed step in one month (giờ Việt Nam): how many times DW1
took a case through it, beside the minutes it takes by hand.
ExportRow.title: ExportRow

ExportSnapshot.description:
The rows of one YCBG as Bravo's "RFQ List" export held them (ticket
11): the title row and the request's own rows, never another request's,
since one export lists every open YCBG and other customers' among them.
Kept on the case instead of the file, it is the place Design's values
are anchored in and what the source pane draws; ``file_sha256`` binds it
to the export it was read from.
ExportSnapshot.title: ExportSnapshot

ExportSnapshotRow.description: One row of a Bravo export as the reader sandbox read it, as text.
ExportSnapshotRow.title: ExportSnapshotRow

FindingCode.description: The order checks of the spec's findings table, one code each.
FindingCode.title: FindingCode

FindingExplanationView.description: An explanation, or why there is none; always marked as the model's.
FindingExplanationView.title: FindingExplanationView

FixedCopper.description: The price does not move with copper.
FixedCopper.title: FixedCopper

FlaggedValueView.description:
A flagged value as the case page is served it: the field, why it is
flagged, and a model's confidence. Never the gate (ticket 44): a value
sampled for the audit must reach its person as any other does, or the
audit would not be blind.
FlaggedValueView.title: FlaggedValueView

FollowupDraftView.description: A draft, or why there is none; always marked as the model's.
FollowupDraftView.title: FollowupDraftView

FromOrder.description:
The order case a quote case was opened from (ticket 09): its id and
PO number, stamped when the quote opened, so both cases name each other.
FromOrder.title: FromOrder

HandledRequest.description: The note a person may leave when they mark a message handled.
HandledRequest.title: HandledRequest

HandledView.description: Where a routed message stands after a mark or a reopen.
HandledView.title: HandledView

Handoff.description:
The pre-filled hand-off stamped on a routed message's disposition.

``read``: some value was located. ``nothing_located``: the model answered
and code kept nothing of it. ``unavailable``: no usable answer. Either of
the last two is an empty form Sales fills by hand, as before.
Handoff.title: Handoff

HandoffDraftView.description:
A routed message's hand-off as code wrote it from the template, for
Sales to review, edit and send from their own mailbox (ticket 33). ``to``
names the team, never an address: Sales picks the recipients.
``kind_label``: the tenant's hand-off skill's words for its kind, where
the skill read it and gives some (ticket 42 family 5).
HandoffDraftView.title: HandoffDraftView

HandoffLine.description: A line of the order the customer asks to change, resolved by code.
HandoffLine.title: HandoffLine

HeadSettingView.description: A setting of the head's short list: where it is, and its sentence.
HeadSettingView.title: HeadSettingView

Hidden.description: An amount the caller may not see: there, and not shown.
Hidden.title: Hidden

ImpliedTermView.description:
A customer's days of silence that count as agreement, as the rules
stamped on the case gave them when the confirmation left (ticket 28).
ImpliedTermView.title: ImpliedTermView

InboxItem.description: One mail in the list a buyer works from.
InboxItem.title: InboxItem

requires_approval.description: True if this tool always requires approval, at every autonomy level. False does not mean it never pauses: whether a given call does depends on the run.
requires_approval.title: Requires Approval

IntentReading.description:
What the model reading of a message's intent did, stamped on its
disposition: the prompt, profile and route of the call, the rules whose
switch asked for it, and the outcome. ``unavailable``: no usable answer
within the retry window, so the message went to Sales as `other`.

Read with the tenant's mail-classifying skill (ticket 42), ``kind`` is a
kind that skill names, ``skill`` the version it was read with,
``routed_as`` the legal route the skill gave that kind and ``kind_label``
the skill's words for it, where it gives some. Read with the one call,
``kind`` is one of the platform's kinds and is its own route.
IntentReading.title: IntentReading

IntentView.description:
One thread intent a model read and code kept (ticket 26), with the
sentences it stands on.
IntentView.title: IntentView

InternalApplyBody.description:
Proterial's own change as a person applies it (ticket 10): why, and
each line with the deliveries PC now gives it.
InternalApplyBody.title: InternalApplyBody

InternalDelivery.description: One delivery a person applies: how much, on PC's date.
InternalDelivery.title: InternalDelivery

InternalDeliveryView.description: A delivery as read: a value None where the paste leaves it to a person.
InternalDeliveryView.title: InternalDeliveryView

InternalLine.description:
One line a person applies, with its deliveries in PC's order; or
``cancelled``, PC cancelling the whole line, with none. A line without
a delivery is a cancel only where it says so: an empty list alone is
refused, never read as one.
InternalLine.title: InternalLine

InternalLineView.description:
A line as read. ``line_no`` None: the words name no line of the order,
refused. ``held_*``: the line as the order holds it, beside what PC gives.
InternalLineView.title: InternalLineView

InternalReadBody.description:
PC's mail as Sales pasted it into "Thay đổi nội bộ" (ticket 10): read,
never stored, to DW1's reading limit (`pc_dates.MAX_TEXT`).
InternalReadBody.title: InternalReadBody

InternalReadView.description:
What DW1 read of the paste, or why nothing: always marked as the
model's on the page, and nothing of it is kept.
InternalReadView.title: InternalReadView

ItemView.description:
An item as the master-data page and the candidate picker show it.
None: the item master does not hold the value (Bravo's holds no MOQ,
lead time or attribute but those its name states, ticket 36).
ItemView.title: ItemView

LabelSummaryView.description: Per step, the cases people decided on its proposals (ticket 43).
LabelSummaryView.title: LabelSummaryView

LabelledAnchor.description: Where one value was read, named by the field (and line) it fills.
LabelledAnchor.title: LabelledAnchor

LateLine.description: One line past its date with less arrived than ordered.
LateLine.title: LateLine

LatencyView.description: The step's time per message, nearest-rank percentiles.
LatencyView.title: LatencyView

LayoutBody.description:
A mapping of the form one message's attachment prints (ticket 30), or
of a portal's export's columns (ticket 18).
LayoutBody.title: LayoutBody

LayoutMapping.description:
Which label on the form names each value, and how its numbers and text
dates are written. A person maps it on the onboarding screen; a model may
pre-fill it.
LayoutMapping.title: LayoutMapping

LayoutPrefill.description:
What the model pre-fill of a form did, stamped on the message it was
asked for and on the layout a person proposed from it: the prompt,
profile and route of the call, the rules whose switch asked, and the
outcome. ``proposed``: every check passed and the screen opens with the
mapping; ``refused``: a check failed (the problems say which), and the
screen opens empty; ``unavailable``: no usable answer.
LayoutPrefill.title: LayoutPrefill

LayoutPreviewView.description: A mapping as code judged it: the problems, and what the reader read.
LayoutPreviewView.title: LayoutPreviewView

LayoutSample.description: The PO the form was mapped from: what the approver sees beside it.
LayoutSample.title: LayoutSample

LayoutSourceView.description:
What the onboarding screen maps from: the form's cells, the pre-fill
DW1 stamped on the message (a model's, where the step is on), and the
customer's layout of this kind already approved, if any.
LayoutSourceView.title: LayoutSourceView

LayoutView.description:
One layout: its mapping, the PO it was mapped from, who proposed and
who decided it, and the model pre-fill it started from, if any.
LayoutView.title: LayoutView

LearnProblem.description:
Why a proposal was refused: a code, the column, a path. Never a word
of the model's, never a cell's value.
LearnProblem.title: LearnProblem

LeftBlank.description:
A column neither the layout nor the rules fill: left for the person
who pastes, as in the file a case draws. Not compared; how many rows of
the PIC's file fill it is shown.
LeftBlank.title: LeftBlank

LineDate.description:
The date Sales confirms for a line delivered once, or, for a line the
PO splits over several schedules, one per schedule in their order
(ticket 35): exactly one of the two.
LineDate.title: LineDate

ListChange.description: One list of a new version beside the one in force.
ListChange.title: ListChange

LiveShareView.description:
What the step handled in the workspace over the last ``window_days``
days, and how much of it DW1 carried (`StepTally`).
LiveShareView.title: LiveShareView

LmeBand.description: The price holds while LME copper is in ``[low, high)`` USD per tonne.
LmeBand.title: LmeBand

Located.description:
Text code found exactly once in the newest part, with its offsets
into the NFKC form of `MessagePart.text`.
Located.title: Located

LockReason.description:
Why the page shows a field without editing it: served with the field,
worded by the web (`rule-labels.ts`, keyed by these values, so a reason
added here fails its typecheck until it has words).
LockReason.title: LockReason

Lookup.description:
The value is what the master data's table holds for it, or for the
field ``key`` where one is named.
Lookup.title: Lookup

MarkIn.description: What a person did with a reminder.
MarkIn.title: MarkIn

MasterDataView.description:
The page: the lists in force and whose, the version waiting to be
decided if any, and the latest uploads.
MasterDataView.title: MasterDataView

MasterImportView.description:
An import as the page shows it: the file, how far it got, and, once
read, what it would change beside the lists in force now.
MasterImportView.title: MasterImportView

MasterUploadBody.description:
A master-data workbook: its name and its bytes, base64. Decoded here
and never opened: the worker reads it in the reader sandbox.
MasterUploadBody.title: MasterUploadBody

PcAnswerBody.description:
PC's answer for one line (ticket 07): its deliveries in PC's order, one
for a line PC delivers at once, several for a line PC splits.

PcAnswerView.description: PC's answer for a line and who recorded it (ticket 07).
PcAnswerView.title: PcAnswerView

PcDatesBody.description:
PC's mail as Sales pasted it (AI item 7): read, never stored. Its
limit is DW1's reading limit (`pc_dates.MAX_TEXT`, its one owner).
PcDatesBody.title: PcDatesBody

PcDatesView.description: The dates read, or why there are none; always marked as the model's.
PcDatesView.title: PcDatesView

PcDeliveryBody.description: One delivery of PC's answer: how much, on which date PC gives.
PcDeliveryBody.title: PcDeliveryBody

PcDeliveryView.description: One delivery of a line as PC confirmed it (ticket 07).
PcDeliveryView.title: PcDeliveryView

PcMailView.description: A verified mail that names the order: what Sales may have DW1 read.
PcMailView.title: PcMailView

PcMailsView.description:
The mails Sales may have DW1 read, and the longest text DW1 reads, a
paste's or a mail's: `MAX_TEXT`, served so the paste box holds no copy of
its own (hardcode audit, finding 22).
PcMailsView.title: PcMailsView

PcRequestStateView.description: Sales asked PC for these lines' dates, and waits (ticket 07).
PcRequestStateView.title: PcRequestStateView

PcRequestView.description:
The request to PC, drafted from the case for a person to copy, and
when DW1 reminds while the case waits on PC (who asked, and when, is the
order's own `pc_request`).
PcRequestView.title: PcRequestView

PcsCostRow.description:
One row of the cost sheet sent to GM/BC Manager: what the request
states, and the price cells left blank for the GM (and Purchasing) to
fill. Never a figure the case does not hold.
PcsCostRow.title: PcsCostRow

PcsCostSheet.description:
The request to GM/BC Manager for a pcs price (ticket 05): the request's
lines, and the cost lines of B49's sheet in its order, every amount
blank.
PcsCostSheet.title: PcsCostSheet

PcsPriceBody.description:
The price GM/BC Manager decided, per line (ticket 05); who recorded it
is the caller, never a field of the request.
PcsPriceBody.title: PcsPriceBody

PcsPriceView.description:
The GM/BC Manager's price for a pcs case (ticket 05), as recorded;
its amounts hidden from a caller who may not read prices.
PcsPriceView.title: PcsPriceView

PendingDecisionView.description:
The platform approval a case waits on: the decision is made there
(`POST /api/v1/approvals/{approval_id}/decisions`), never on a Sales
route. Present only while the case is in the state that waits on it.
PendingDecisionView.title: PendingDecisionView

PlatformDocumentView.description:
One version of a key the platform released, whole: what a proposal may
start from and what a diff compares with while the platform's applies.
PlatformDocumentView.title: PlatformDocumentView

PoRound.description: The orders drafted for a case, and the layout their file is drawn with.
PoRound.title: PoRound

PoUploadBody.description:
"Tải PO lên": the customer a person chose and the files they dropped.
Who uploads is the caller, never a field here.
PoUploadBody.title: PoUploadBody

PoUploadView.description:
What one upload did: the message it is, whether it was stored now or
already, and its processing job when one was queued.
PoUploadView.title: PoUploadView

PrSource.title: PrSource

PrintDifferenceView.description:
A value the PO's second file shows differently, where it shows it, and
both values as each file prints them (ticket 22; None for a difference
stored before they were kept).
PrintDifferenceView.title: PrintDifferenceView

ProcessingJobView.description:
A message's processing job (ticket 25): ids, a status and a reason
code, never anything read from the message.
ProcessingJobView.title: ProcessingJobView

ProcessingQueuedView.description: What "DW xử lý tất cả" queued (ticket 25): one job per message.
ProcessingQueuedView.title: ProcessingQueuedView

PromptReplay.description:
What the version was proposed on: the labelled cases replayed, how
many the platform's (or the version in force) read right and how many
this one does, and the security cases it passed. Counts only.
PromptReplay.title: PromptReplay

PromptVersionView.description: A tenant's version of the prompt, as the head's page shows it.
PromptVersionView.title: PromptVersionView

PromptsView.description:
The description reading's prompt for the tenant: the platform's
prompt the versions add to, the version in force and what it shows, and
every version of the tenant's, newest first.
PromptsView.title: PromptsView

ProposalView.description:
What a turn stated for the PIC to confirm: a flag's decision
(``action`` decide_finding) or a Bravo write (bravo_write).
ProposalView.title: ProposalView

PurchaseCase.description:
One request, from the moment DW2 received it.

(``purchasing_rules@<version>``), stamped once: a later reader takes the
stamp, never whatever is in force today.
PurchaseCase.title: PurchaseCase

PurchaseCheckView.description: What the check found and who would approve, under the rules in force.
PurchaseCheckView.title: PurchaseCheckView

PurchaseRequest-Input.description: What the requester asked for, as they wrote it.
PurchaseRequest-Input.title: PurchaseRequest

PurchaseRequest-Output.description: What the requester asked for, as they wrote it.
PurchaseRequest-Output.title: PurchaseRequest

PurchasingModelStep.description:

PurchasingModelStep.title: PurchasingModelStep

PurchasingRuleKey.description: What a tenant may hold its own version of.
PurchasingRuleKey.title: PurchasingRuleKey

PurchasingRuleVersionView.description: A version as the settings page lists it.
PurchasingRuleVersionView.title: PurchasingRuleVersionView

PurchasingRuleWordsBody.description: What a person wants changed, in their words, and the part it is about.
PurchasingRuleWordsBody.title: PurchasingRuleWordsBody

PushKeyView.title: PushKeyView

QuantityChange.description: The line's quantity, in the sales unit Bravo's `Quantity9` holds.
QuantityChange.title: QuantityChange

QuestionKind.description: What DW1 answers (the agreed list), and everything else.
QuestionKind.title: QuestionKind

QuotationRowView.description: A quotation in the evidence or the master data.
QuotationRowView.title: QuotationRowView

opened it and when, and its status now. ``status`` None: the caller does
not see that quote case, and is shown only that it exists.
QuoteLinkView.title: QuoteLinkView

ReadBackBody.description:
Read the case's SO back from Bravo (ticket 51), at the case version
the PIC is looking at.
ReadBackBody.title: ReadBackBody

ReadBackView.description:
A case's read-back as its page shows it. ``stale``: the case changed
since it was compared. A unit price's values are left out for a viewer
who may not read prices.
ReadBackView.title: ReadBackView

ReadFrom.description:
Where in a mail DW2 read the request, when a document was attached:
the file (its id in the stored mailbox, and its name) when the lines
were in it (None: the mail's own words), and whether any value was read
only on a scanned page, which a person compares with the paper before
DW2 sends it on (`review`).
ReadFrom.title: ReadFrom

ReadIntent.description: One intent code kept, standing on the quotes it located.
ReadIntent.title: ReadIntent

A choice of suppliers whose total passed what the approver's tier
decides (plus the tenant's tolerance), sent to the tier that total names:
the choice waits here, and becomes the case's selection only once that
approver approves it. ``explanation`` is the model's words for why, kept
only when every figure in them is one of code's facts; None otherwise.

Receipt.description: Goods of one line that arrived, as a buyer recorded them.
Receipt.title: Receipt

would see something else than the reader read.

spans: the lines, and the request-wide values the words name. No PR

numbers the request, the requester is the signed-in person).

StalledEventView.description:

StatedAttributesView.description:
What the description stated of the attributes the candidate picker

StepAutonomyView.description: One step's line on the head's view (ticket 44).

TemplateHeader.description:

ThreadCaseBody.description:

ThreadSummaryView.description: A summary, or why there is none; always marked as the model's.

Tier.description: What a step's effect is, and so whether its result may apply itself.

TypedChange.description:

UnappliedDecisionView.description:

UnitFactor.description: Multiplies the value by how many ``to`` make one ``from``.

UnopenedValue.description: A value of the order nobody was served the page or sheet of.

UpdateAnswerBody.description:

UpdateApprovalBody.description: The Bravo update file the PIC approves, drawn at ``case_version``.

UploadFileBody.description:

ValueConfirmationView.description: One value a model read, as Sales confirmed it (ticket 29).

post.description:
Stop the run in flight on this thread.

The runner's own `cancel_thread` takes a thread id and nothing else: it
looks the task up in an in-process dict, which is safe while the only caller
is a run that started it. Over HTTP the id is whatever the caller typed, so
ownership is established HERE, against the database under the caller's
tenant, before the runner is asked to do anything.

A thread this tenant has never run on is a 404 rather than a 403. "Not
yours" and "never existed" are the same answer to someone probing ids, and
the difference between them is exactly what a prober is trying to learn.
